intervals.note: No fetched source states the first or last NA44 run. Evidence: proton and sulphur data accumulated by FY1992 (KAKEN report, project period 'FY 1991 - 1992'); the 1994 lead run (arXiv:2603.10835: 'Operating the detector in the experiment during the 1994 lead run') and 1994/1995 Si-pad data (thesis: 'the data recorded in 1994 ... the 1995 data'). Both bounds are therefore uncertain.
intervals.quote: we have accumulated a large amount of raw deta on 450-GeV proton-nucleus and 200-GeV/nucleon sulphur-nucleus collisions

summary.plain: A focusing magnetic spectrometer that measures the momentum and identity of a few particles per collision, with a Cherenkov counter and time-of-flight to separate pions, kaons and protons.
summary.technical: NA44: focusing spectrometer for one- and two-particle measurements near mid-rapidity; threshold imaging Cherenkov detector (CsI photocathodes) for pi/K separation at 4-8 GeV/c, time-of-flight, silicon pad multiplicity array and a lead target.

technology.quote: The NA44 collaboration built a novel Threshold Imaging Cherenkov (TIC) detector
technology.value: Focusing magnetic spectrometer with a threshold imaging Cherenkov counter (CsI photocathodes) and time-of-flight for pi/K separation
